a.lede: Lie down in a car, and you’re more likely to get seriously hurt in a crash. But a driverless future is forcing governments to revisit long-standing safety issues.
a.title: Self-Driving Cars Might Change Crash Testing Forever

b.lede: Modern cars are fitted with features like autonomous emergency braking and fatigue monitoring. But do they support motorists or drive them to distraction? This new car I’m test-driving boasts all the latest bells and whistles – or, rather, beeps and bings. Peer sideways for too long checking traffic and the car emits an irritating sound. Should I take a hand
b.title: ‘In this new car, I feel patronised’: which driver assistance systems actually improve safety?
